summary: Source-qualified October 29 regulatory and energy events from the completed October 29 noon to October 30 midnight evidence review. Inspection covered three incoming event leads, four later-event updates, five attributed claims and three economic observations. Accepted only independently source-checked license supersession, oil borrowing awards, reported executive withdrawals and separately qualified Taiz medical access evidence. Other purported military damage, drone capture, election claims and provisional casualty reports remain unadjudicated referrals or unchanged. No complete historical missed-sweep recovery, no WOL/Lie Ledger change and no map-coordinate or protected market series change.

events.summary: OFAC General License FF-1 effective October 29 replaced FF of October 15, authorizing only specifically enumerated wind-down transactions involving Iraq Development Bank and its 50%-owned entities until 12:01 AM EST December 1. Payment to a blocked person must enter a blocked account. This is not sanctions rescission or proof that money moved.

U.S. Department of Energy reported contracts awarded Oct28 for about 16.8 million barrels of SPR oil loans, following about 23.8 million awarded Oct13. Roughly 40 million barrels in combined awards implements part of the existing 172 million US international reserve-release commitment. Awarded borrowing contracts are not physical deliveries or a new 40 million barrels on top of 172 million.

Reuters sources said ExxonMobil CEO Darren Woods and Chevron upstream president Clay Neff canceled trips to the upcoming Abu Dhabi ADIPEC energy conference amid security concerns. Neither a new UAE strike nor the cancellation of the conference itself is established; its organizer expected over 120 US exhibitors.

Reuters reported hospital and Red Cross accounts of severe pressure on Taiz medical services, with facilities treating up to 700 war wounded weekly and large displacement since August. These are source-attributed capacity and displaced-person observations, not a new count of conflict deaths or proof all roads were identically closed.
